router_holds_erc20.meaning: ERC20 token balances are already sitting on the TrailsRouter contract

tokens_stranded_by_victims.meaning: Tokens held by the router were stranded there by victims

caller_authorized_for_router_assets.meaning: the caller is the party whose assets are being spent, i.e. spending of router-held assets is tied to the caller supplying the transaction

pooled_balances_drained.meaning: pooled ERC20 balances held by the router are drained by the caller

assumptions: injectAndCall is callable by any caller (permissionless) as stated by the headline 'any caller'.
The forwarded amount is the router's existing self balance for the token, per the root-cause statement.

unresolved.description: Report does not state an explicit access-control check or authorization predicate on injectAndCall; the 'tied to the caller' requirement is inferred, so the authorization observable is a qualitative Boolean rather than a concrete check.

limitations: Authorization is represented as a qualitative Boolean because the report gives no concrete guard or numeric definition; code binding is deferred.
No concrete token amounts, victim identities, or transaction hashes are provided, so the drain is modeled as a Boolean outcome rather than a quantified balance change.
